## [purpose] Purpose

Using dummy equipment, follow the trainer-approved safety checklist and demonstrate immediate reporting and referral for a simulated needlestick.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

75 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 4 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Obtain the trainer-approved local checklist and dummy equipment. Do not run a clinical demonstration without a qualified trainer and safe materials. Put the emergency contact on the practice card.

## [opening] Opening

Ana has a used-needle injury but no symptoms. What should she do?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The first response follows the required sequence. Washing alone is insufficient; waiting can delay time-critical assessment and treatment. A qualified provider decides treatment.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Uses real used sharps in practice, misses a critical safety step or delays medical evaluation. Demonstrate safe practice; after exposure, obtain help immediately without waiting for symptoms.

## [practice] Practice activity

Use a dummy box to show when replacement is needed. Follow the local demonstration checklist for hand hygiene and PPE. Then rehearse a needlestick: state the first action, call the simulated contact and arrange immediate evaluation. In pairs, record any delay or unsafe step and repeat. Alone, rehearse reporting; a trainer must observe the physical demonstration. Before duty, know where to obtain immediate evaluation.

## [answer-key] Answer key

1. Wash, report immediately and obtain immediate medical evaluation.

The first response follows the required sequence. Washing alone is insufficient; waiting can delay time-critical assessment and treatment. A qualified provider decides treatment.

## [observe] Observe

Follows each critical step of the local demonstration checklist, places and replaces the dummy box correctly, and reports and obtains evaluation immediately in simulation.

Ready: Follows each critical step of the local demonstration checklist, places and replaces the dummy box correctly, and reports and obtains evaluation immediately in simulation. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Follows a safe sequence but needs a prompt for the reporting contact; repeat until contact and pathway are clear.

Not yet: Uses real used sharps in practice, misses a critical safety step or delays medical evaluation.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Follows a safe sequence but needs a prompt for the reporting contact; repeat until contact and pathway are clear. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23; CDC — Best Practices for Occupational Exposure to Blood (https://www.cdc.gov/dental-infection-control/hcp/dental-ipc-faqs/occupational-exposure.html). The five hazard groups span both source-table pages. A local clinical trainer must review demonstrations and referral pathways. Immediate needlestick evaluation was checked against CDC on 25 September 2026. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

## [purpose] Layunin

Gamit ang dummy equipment, sundin ang trainer-approved safety checklist at ipakita ang agarang reporting at referral response sa simulated needlestick.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

75 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 4 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Kumuha ng trainer-approved local checklist at dummy equipment. Walang clinical demonstration kung walang qualified trainer at ligtas na kagamitan. Ilagay ang emergency contact sa practice card.

## [opening] Pambungad

Natusok si Ana ng used needle ngunit walang sintomas. Ano ang gagawin?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang unang sagot ang tamang sequence. Hindi sapat ang paghuhugas lamang; maaaring maantala ng paghihintay ang time-critical na assessment at treatment. Qualified provider ang magpapasya sa paggamot.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Humahawak ng tunay na used sharps sa practice, lumalaktaw sa critical safety step o nagpapaliban ng medical evaluation. Ipakita ang ligtas na gawain; sa exposure, agarang tulong ang una at hindi hinihintay ang sintomas.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Ipakita gamit ang dummy box kung kailan kailangan ng replacement. Sundin ang lokal na demo checklist para sa hand hygiene at PPE. Pagkatapos, gumanap sa needlestick scenario: sabihin ang unang hakbang, tawagan ang kunwaring contact at ayusin ang agarang evaluation. Sa pares, itala ang anumang delay o unsafe step at ulitin. Kung mag-isa, i-rehearse ang reporting sequence; ang physical demo ay kailangang makita ng trainer. Bago ang duty, alamin kung saan pupunta para sa agarang evaluation.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

1. Hugasan, iulat agad at magpa-medical evaluation kaagad.

Ang unang sagot ang tamang sequence. Hindi sapat ang paghuhugas lamang; maaaring maantala ng paghihintay ang time-critical na assessment at treatment. Qualified provider ang magpapasya sa paggamot.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Nasusunod ang bawat critical step ng lokal na demo checklist; tama ang placement at replacement ng dummy box; agad ang report at medical evaluation sa simulation.

Kaya na: Nasusunod ang bawat critical step ng lokal na demo checklist; tama ang placement at replacement ng dummy box; agad ang report at medical evaluation sa simulation. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Ligtas ang sequence ngunit nangangailangan ng prompt sa reporting contact; ipaulit hanggang malinaw ang contact at pathway.

Hindi pa: Humahawak ng tunay na used sharps sa practice, lumalaktaw sa critical safety step o nagpapaliban ng medical evaluation.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Ligtas ang sequence ngunit nangangailangan ng prompt sa reporting contact; ipaulit hanggang malinaw ang contact at pathway. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23; CDC — Best Practices for Occupational Exposure to Blood (https://www.cdc.gov/dental-infection-control/hcp/dental-ipc-faqs/occupational-exposure.html). Ang limang hazard group ay mula sa dalawang pahina ng source table. Suriin ng lokal na clinical trainer ang demo at referral pathway. Ang agarang needlestick evaluation ay sinuri sa CDC noong 25 Setyembre 2026. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.

## [exposure] If stuck, act immediately

Ana, 33, is in a health-station safety practice. The injury in the next example is simulated; no real needles or body fluids are used.

After a used-needle injury, wash the wound with soap and water. Report immediately to the midwife or designated supervisor and obtain immediate medical evaluation from a qualified provider. Do not wait until the end of the shift or for symptoms. A clinician decides on assessment and any post-exposure treatment. Document the event through the local incident process so the cause can also be addressed.

## [return-demo] A safe return demonstration

Using dummy equipment, show where the sharps container belongs and when replacement is needed. Demonstrate hand hygiene and PPE use/removal following the trainer-approved local protocol. Practice uses no real used needles or body fluids. In a short posture exercise, adjust the chair and bag; avoid painful stretching. The facilitator observes actions rather than relying only on verbal answers.

## [near-miss] Report a near miss too

Ana nearly slips but nobody is hurt. Report the hazard, time, location and control through the local process. After an incident, prepare available information for referral and any applicable benefits process, but paperwork must not delay urgent care. BHW insurance and benefits are not identical; confirm your applicable arrangements with the coordinator.

## [practice] Try it, then repeat

Use a dummy box to show when replacement is needed. Follow the local demonstration checklist for hand hygiene and PPE. Then rehearse a needlestick: state the first action, call the simulated contact and arrange immediate evaluation. In pairs, record any delay or unsafe step and repeat. Alone, rehearse reporting; a trainer must observe the physical demonstration. Before duty, know where to obtain immediate evaluation.

## [check] Choose the next step

Choose an answer and explain why before viewing the feedback. Then compare it with your own practice attempt.

## [exposure] Kung natusok, kumilos agad

Si Ana, 33, ay nasa safety practice sa health station. Ang injury sa susunod na halimbawa ay simulation; walang tunay na karayom o body fluid sa pagsasanay.

Kung natusok ng ginamit na karayom, hugasan ang sugat gamit ang sabon at tubig. Iulat agad sa midwife o nakatalagang supervisor at kumuha kaagad ng medical evaluation sa kwalipikadong provider. Huwag hintaying matapos ang duty o magkaroon ng sintomas. Ang clinician ang magpapasya sa pagsusuri at anumang kailangan na post-exposure treatment. Itala ang pangyayari sa lokal na incident process upang matugunan din ang dahilan ng aksidente.

## [return-demo] Return demonstration na ligtas

Gamit ang dummy equipment, ipakita kung saan dapat naroon ang sharps container at kung kailan kailangang palitan. Ipakita ang hand hygiene at paggamit/pagtanggal ng PPE ayon sa trainer-approved local protocol. Walang tunay na ginamit na karayom o body fluid sa practice. Sa maikling activity tungkol sa posisyon, ayusin ang upuan at bag; huwag gumawa ng masakit na stretch. Ang facilitator ang titingin sa kilos, hindi lang sa pagsagot.

## [near-miss] Iulat kahit muntik lamang

Muntik madulas si Ana pero walang nasaktan. Mahalaga pa ring iulat ang hazard, oras, lugar at ginawang kontrol sa lokal na proseso. Kung may insidente, ihanda ang available na impormasyon para sa referral at naaangkop na benefits process, ngunit huwag hayaang maantala ng papel ang agarang pangangalaga. Hindi lahat ng BHW ay pareho ang insurance o benepisyo; kumpirmahin sa coordinator kung ano ang naaangkop sa iyo.

## [practice] Subukan, saka ulitin

Ipakita gamit ang dummy box kung kailan kailangan ng replacement. Sundin ang lokal na demo checklist para sa hand hygiene at PPE. Pagkatapos, gumanap sa needlestick scenario: sabihin ang unang hakbang, tawagan ang kunwaring contact at ayusin ang agarang evaluation. Sa pares, itala ang anumang delay o unsafe step at ulitin. Kung mag-isa, i-rehearse ang reporting sequence; ang physical demo ay kailangang makita ng trainer. Bago ang duty, alamin kung saan pupunta para sa agarang evaluation.

## [check] Piliin ang susunod na hakbang

Piliin ang sagot at ipaliwanag kung bakit bago tingnan ang feedback. Pagkatapos, ihambing sa sarili mong ginawa sa pagsasanay.
